title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity bumps across py/ts/go (v1.25.0)
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: This PR consolidates recent SDK changes across Python, TypeScript, and Go: unified auth/retries semantics, streaming API ergonomics, and a set of parity fixes plus coordinated version bumps to v1.25.0. Motivation: customer integrations showed inconsistencies across SDKs around token refresh behavior, retry backoff semantics, and streaming event shapes. Having different ergonomics caused developer confusion and made cross-platform examples brittle. This change set: 1) Auth/retries: standardized credential refresh hook shape, moved auth token refresh into a shared retryable interceptor (exponential backoff with jitter, default 3 retries for idempotent calls, 0 for non-idempotent streaming start) and unified env var naming (REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY, added REDWOOD_TOKEN_REFRESH_URL for refresh flows). 2) Streaming ergonomics: unified client-side streaming iterator semantics (Python: async generator yields ResponseEvent objects; TS: AsyncIterable<ResponseEvent>; Go: channel of ResponseEvent) and aligned event types (chunk|delta|final|done) and error propagation rules. 3) Parity fixes: fixed minor API surface mismatches (missing param name 'timeout_ms' in TS, Go's ClientOptions had differing default for 'max_connections'), harmonized docstrings and examples. 4) Version bumps: updated package versions to v1.25.0 across SDKs, updated changelogs and release metadata. Testing: added cross-SDK integration tests that run against the local mock inference server (redwood/benchmark-lab mock harness), unit tests for retry edge cases, and streaming golden fixtures for event ordering. Migration notes: existing users should be unaffected for common flows; if customers use custom retry hooks they must adapt to the new interceptor signature. For streaming, event shape changed slightly (delta now includes 'partial' boolean) -- see migration section in CHANGES.md. Rollout: feature flagged behind 'sdk-unify-auth-v1.25' for 48h, staged release across package registries. Related: ENG-3421 (auth parity), ENG-3498 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-1182 (customer-reported retry flapping).
commits: Initial cross-sdk consolidation: auth + retries refactor
TS: add retry interceptor and streaming AsyncIterable shim
Python: async generator for streaming + unify token refresh hook
Go: introduce ResponseEvent type + channel-based streaming client
tests: add integration harness + golden streaming fixtures
docs: migration notes and changelogs, bump versions to v1.25.0

Lena Fischer: Noted that Go example didn't close response channels on error; author fixed and added unit. Lena: approve and marked for merge.
CI: initial run failed on lint (ts) - fixed missing exports and re-ran. CI: all checks passed on re-run.
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth token refresh hook and retry interceptor (standardized backoff + jitter), streaming APIs now yield standardized ResponseEvent shapes across Python/TS/Go, parity fixes and ergonomics improvements, bumped SDK versions to v1.25.0. Migration: see docs/sdk-migration-auth-retries.md and docs/sdk-migration-streaming.md for details.
